description: Source code for Feishu Bitable API integration, including functions for URL parsing, metadata retrieval, CRUD operations on tables and records, and tool registration for plugin use.

classes.name: LarkApiError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling Lark API errors with additional context.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Helper function to format data as JSON content for responses.

methods.name: ensureLarkSuccess
methods.description: Checks API response success and throws error if failed.

methods.name: parseBitableUrl
methods.description: Extracts tokens and URL type from a Bitable URL.

methods.name: getAppTokenFromWiki
methods.description: Retrieves app token from a wiki node token.

methods.name: getBitableMeta
methods.description: Fetches metadata for a Bitable URL, including app token and table info.

methods.name: listFields
methods.description: Lists all fields in a specified Bitable table.

methods.name: listRecords
methods.description: Lists records from a Bitable table with pagination.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a single record by ID.

methods.name: createRecord
methods.description: Creates a new record in a Bitable table.

methods.name: cleanupNewBitable
methods.description: Removes default placeholder fields and rows in a new Bitable.

methods.name: createApp
methods.description: Creates a new Bitable application and cleans up default data.

methods.name: createField
methods.description: Creates a new field (column) in a Bitable table.

methods.name: updateRecord
methods.description: Updates an existing record in a Bitable table.

methods.name: registerFeishuBitableTools
methods.description: Registers Bitable-related tools for the plugin API.
